projects.title: Global Campaign Management and Reporting Tool (MALT)
projects.description: Architected and developed a centralized tool enabling Ubisoft's globally distributed teams to efficiently manage and track diverse marketing campaigns. This tool supports campaign tracking and URL generation with embedded tracking parameters that feed into Adobe SiteCatalyst for performance monitoring on supported sites. It accommodates a range of campaign types—from digital efforts like email and web traffic to broader initiatives such as TV and radio ads—providing a unified platform for campaign organization and oversight.  Beyond tracking, the tool centralizes vendor and agency management, aligns media and social data with Ubisoft’s data warehouses (Vertica, MySQL), and delivers real-time reporting through interactive visualizations built with D3.js. Developed with AngularJS and PHP, this solution streamlines global marketing operations, empowering data-driven decision-making and supporting efficient collaboration across teams and regions.

This would allow staging the data for inclusion in many different backends as needed.

projects.title: Analytics Tracking Alternative (POC) - AWS Kinesis Firehose
projects.description: Developed proof-of-concept tooling to allow tracking of high traffic metrics collection of sites and / or integrations.  This tooling was developed as a potential alternative to Adobe Analytics for sites that were deemed to intensive for Adobe Analytics and so was a potential way to curb costs (Adobe use a quota billing approach, that was very expensive for certain properties).   In order to achieve this goal, I was asked to research potential alternatives; ideally using Kinesis from AWS.  I was able to meet this target by integrating using Javascript, AWS Javascript SDK, and Kinesis/Firehose.  The resulting tooling would allow for 12TB of data ingestion for around $500/mo (see https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/firehose/pricing/).

projects.title: Apache revamp
projects.description: Revamped legacy apache environment.  Previously, configurations were built per machine, and so presented certain management challenges.  For the new implementation, developed configurations agnostically, and implemented in a virtualized fashion so as to provide ease of scale.  Front end was all built around F5 load balancers, balancing across virtual apache servers.

projects.title: Gale GOLD Team - Network & Resource manager
projects.description: Designed, developed and automated a set of tools to collect and display analytical information about our environments.  While the analytics was a key component, many technologies evolved out of this project; including a graphical UI developed in php and javascript (layered on top of mootools/mochaui), several tools to monitor and report about JVM heap events (usage, classes loaded, events triggered, etc).  Additionally, tools were also integrated that allowed a layered approach to management of the environments.

projects.title: Netapp - administration wrapper
projects.description: Tool to facilitate scheduling of jobs and ease of administration of Netapp snapshot processes.  Developed using Java and JSCH, allowed complicated snapshot tasks to be automated and repeatable.

projects.title: Resource visualizer
projects.description: Developed tool to allow ease of understanding across environments.  With the architecture in place, and in some cases, development requiring large number of environments for testing purposes; we found ourselves having trouble managing the vast number of servers (approached over 700 at the time); we needed a tool that would help us visualize how are servers were organized, and where we had colocated services for small environments (in many cases, it was more cost effective to stack services on the same hardware).  This was accomplished by developing a small database application in PHP that we could use to track these decisions.  This allowed for us to go to a page, select the service; and the system would then provide us insight into what else we had allocated to that host.  This was a pre-cursor to other systems we would end up developing internally to help with our mgmt burden.

projects.title: Perl / XLS proprietary audit tool

This tool was still in use as of December 2011.

Worked with B2B Engineering team to integrate their system to the new endpoint, and worked with downstream consumers to facilitate rapid ingestion into the data lake.  This integration has elevated ingestion by 8B+ ingestions per month, resulting in ~300B impressions per year.

projects.title: Amplitude to Snowflake Connector Implementation

projects.title: Airflow Pipeline Integration with Snowflake
projects.description: Initially as Manager, and later as Senior Manager, I oversaw this year-long initiative (Feb 2022 - Mar 2023) to integrate numerous ETL pipelines into Snowflake. As the senior leader on this project, I managed the high-level integrations and platform updates that empowered other teams to build and migrate their pipelines seamlessly.   My role focused on orchestrating the necessary infrastructure, aligning resources, and ensuring consistent connectivity, creating a robust foundation for the transition of critical pipelines. This initiative enhanced data workflows, improved reliability, and significantly reduced manual intervention across the platform.

projects.title: Data Sharing Integrations via Snowflake
projects.description: Led multiple initiatives to implement Snowflake’s Data Sharing feature across both external vendors and internal accounts, enabling seamless, real-time data access. By leveraging Snowflake’s native data-sharing capabilities, we reduced storage costs, eliminated data duplication, and provided teams with immediate access to critical business insights across various trusted sources.

projects.title: Proactive SSL Resolution to Restore Foundry Data Synchronizations
projects.description: Proactively identified and resolved a critical SSL validation issue in Palantir Foundry that had gone unnoticed, impacting over 100 data synchronizations. Collaborated with the infrastructure team to update SSL certificates on AWS RDS instances, implemented client certificates for secure communication, and successfully restored full synchronization functionality.   Given the substantial cost of Foundry, this resolution not only restored critical data workflows but also directly improved the organization’s ROI by minimizing downtime and maximizing platform efficiency.

projects.title: Migration from Spot Instances for Coder Kubernetes Cluster
projects.description: Took on the project of migrating our Coder Kubernetes cluster away from spot instances to improve stability and reduce disruptions. My role involved aligning with the development operations team to finalize and implement a pending merge request from the previous lead engineer.  Through close collaboration and coordination, we successfully transitioned the cluster to a more reliable instance type, ensuring consistent uptime and enhancing the developer experience across the platform.

projects.title: Optimization of Coder Workspace Creation and Start Times
projects.description: Led an initiative to improve efficiency within Coder by transitioning developer workspaces to a static Docker image, reducing workspace creation times from 20 minutes to 5 minutes and enabling start times of under a minute for already-created workspaces.   For application workspaces, I created a staged build approach for the static image, reducing workspace  creation times to 2.5 minutes and achieving start times of just 30 seconds. These optimizations improved the environment's responsiveness, providing engineering and analysis teams with a more efficient and reliable setup.

projects.title: Rosy Economix: An Economic Data Analysis Tool
projects.description: Developed the full-stack Rosy Economix application as a capstone project to investigate the relationship between economic indicators and financial markets. This tool integrates data from multiple sources, including the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) and Yahoo Finance, automating retrieval, storage, and analysis workflows using Apache Airflow and PostgreSQL. With a front end built in React and a FastAPI backend, Rosy Economix visualizes data correlations, overlays significant government interventions, and provides users with insights into economic trends. Key features include a correlation analysis of indicators like GDP and unemployment rates, credit delinquency analysis, and interactive visualizations for exploring stock market impacts using Chart.js.  The project also incorporates OpenAI’s multi-model API via REST, adding capabilities for advanced analysis and natural language interactions. One of the highlights is the automation of dbt workflows, visualized through React Flow to map dbt tables and their relationships—bringing data lineage to life in an intuitive format. Future enhancements could include infrastructure like Kafka or Flink, as well as potential integration with vendors like Polygon.io.

projects.title: Data Platform Migration and Modernization Project
projects.description: Led Glassdoor’s migration from an aging HDP Hadoop cluster to a modern data architecture, transitioning non-critical pipelines to EMR/Hive/Presto/Spark and critical datasets to Snowflake. Managed three core teams (Data Platform Infrastructure, Engineering, and Reporting Services) and coordinated across Data Engineering, Data Science, ML Operations, and an external Narwal team (4-6 engineers, with over a dozen involved overall). Ensured the environment supported self-service data access, empowering teams to efficiently leverage company data. Established training, maintained data quality, and aligned all stakeholders to achieve a seamless transition.

projects.title: Google Sheets + AI Platform – Prompt Experimentation Framework
projects.description: Built a Google Sheets integration that enabled product and research stakeholders to run controlled A/B tests for prompt engineering directly from a spreadsheet UI. Connected Sheets to GIA’s backend via custom Apps Script functions and API bindings, allowing teams to configure, deploy, and evaluate prompt variants with zero code changes. Designed for safety, reproducibility, and non-engineer usability.  * Created end-user-facing menu extensions and Apps Script functions * Integrated with FastAPI backend to dispatch and track prompt variants * Enabled safe experimentation with structured prompt evaluation * Improved team velocity by eliminating engineer bottlenecks in prompt iteration * Integrated Gemini for comparative analysis
